_comment: Built-in AI provider routing table. name -> {api_format, base_url, env_key}. NO model: models change too often to pin one here, so a provider named with no model fails loud asking for an explicit model string. A coder overrides any row with their own `address`/`key` in an ai.connect block, and the coder's values win. This file is the one the out-of-band refresh mechanism (T1-SHIPPED-DATA-OUT-OF-BAND-REFRESH) will update, which is why it carries only endpoints and env-key names, never volatile model strings.
